````python
import networkx as nx
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
G = nx.Graph()
DG = nx.DiGraph()
# G Befehle auch für DG nutzbar
G.add_node("A")
G.add_nodes_from([1,2,3,4])
G.remove_node(1)
G.add_edge(3,4)
G.add_edges_from([(1,2),(2,3)])
G.add_edge(3,4,weight=2)
edges = [('S','A',6),('S','B',12)]
G.add_weighted_edges_from(edges)
G.remove_edge(1,2)
G=nx.relabel_nodes(G,{0:'A', 1:'B'})
list(G.neighbors(1))
G.copy()
G.degree
DG.in_degree
DG.out_degree
````
